newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork seeks option to buy Golden assets.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork seeks option to buy Golden assets.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc said it signed a letter of intent with ACX Technologies Inc to buy for $10 million an option to purchase ACX's Golden Aluminum Co unit at any time during a two-year period.
If Crown exercised its option, it said it would pay ACX $60 million to buy substantially all of Golden Aluminum.
ACX was expected to retain a minority equity interest in Golden Aluminum as well as all of Golden Aluminum's working capital, the company said.
Golden Aluminum uses continuous block casting or mini-mill technology to produce aluminum for use in canmaking, among other capabilities, Crown said.
"The option will enable us to expand the potential for mini-mill technology and is an attractive but prudent investment for the company," William Avery, Crown's chairman, said.
The transaction would close following completion of definitive agreements approval by the boards and any necessary regulatory approvals, it said.
